I am having some trouble scheduling a cronjob. I have created the config file and have everything set up, but each time I hit save it says something about a bad minute. I looked on stackoverflow and they mentioned that this error pops up when your command takes up more than one line. Mine does not. I am trying to get a reddit bot to run once an hour, nothing major here. Does anyone know of a good tutorial that I could follow?

Which cron are you using? Vixie-cron, dcron, mcron and cronie are all slightly different. Vixie-cron, for example, will allow you to declare variables in your crontab, so you can set up a PATH in your crontab. Most of the rest require you to explicitly type out the PATH to your script or executable.

The format is pretty consistent across cron-types:

 # * * * * * command to execute
 # │ │ │ │ │
 # │ │ │ │ │
 # │ │ │ │ └───── day of week (0 - 6) (0 to 6 are Sunday to Saturday, or use names; 7 is Sunday, the same as 0)
 # │ │ │ └────────── month (1 - 12)
 # │ │ └─────────────── day of month (1 - 31)
 # │ └──────────────────── hour (0 - 23)
 # └───────────────────────── min (0 - 59)

Some crons use the slash (/) format for executing multiple times. For instance */5 in the first column would execute every 5 minutes in vixie-cron. Not sure about the others.
